question: BCG is the vaccine for tuberculosis. What is the full form of BCG?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Bacille Calmette-Guerin**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) is tuberculosis (TB) vaccine**.
 
• Many foreign-born people have had BCG vaccinations. In several TB-endemic countries, BCG is used to prevent children's tuberculous meningitis and miliary disease.
 
• **Doctor Albert Calmette **(1863-1933) was the pioneer of antituberculous BCG vaccination and **antivenomous serotherapy.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information __**

 
• Dr. Albert Calmette established the** first daughter Pasteur Institute **for the protection against rabies and smallpox.
 
• **Mycobacterium tuberculosis** is the bacteria that causes tuberculosis (TB).
 
• TB germs often attack the lungs, but they can affect any** region of the body, including the kidney, spine, and brain. **Not everyone infected with tuberculosis becomes ill.
